description: Permissions granted to embedded browser webviews (label prefix `smirk-browser-`). Scope is intentionally narrow: only what the `@smirk/dapp-api` injection script needs to forward `window.smirk.X()` calls to the wallet — `event:allow-emit` and `event:allow-listen`. NOTHING else is granted, so a malicious page can't reach plugin-store, plugin-shell, plugin-updater, or any other Tauri surface.
